description: A per-candidate selective allocation funnel for large candidate portfolios. It spends frontier resources only after an open problem and a concrete bridge survive evidence-bound admission and independent audit, while configured stage concurrency concentrates the portfolio on rare survivors.

agent_owns: problem interpretation within the frozen statement
whether evidence warrants a configured transition or pause
policy_owns: evidence needed to unlock the next allocation tier

statement_frozen.description: The exact quantified public statement and success criterion are frozen.

authoritative_source_verified.description: An authoritative source for the statement has been recorded.

open_status_verified.description: A dated primary-source search supports that the exact statement remains open.

duplicate_risk_cleared.description: Known direct corollaries and duplicate formulations were checked.

decisive_kill_test_defined.description: A cheap test capable of killing the proposed attack has an executable specification.

bridge_relevance_established.description: The candidate bridge has an explicit implication path to the original problem.

admission_rejected.description: The target failed admission for a recorded mathematical or novelty reason.

bridge_verified.description: A theorem-shaped bridge, reduction, invariant, or obstruction was proved with a complete implication interface.

bridge_refuted.description: The bridge mechanism or its claimed implication was decisively refuted.

independent_bridge_audit_passed.description: A fresh reviewer reconstructed the bridge and its relevance to the original statement.

independent_bridge_audit_failed.description: A fresh reviewer found a fatal bridge or dependency defect.

original_problem_closed.description: A complete proof of the frozen original statement is claimed with a dependency graph.

counterexample_closed.description: A rigorous counterexample refuting the frozen original statement is claimed.

standalone_theorem_candidate.description: A paper-scale intermediate theorem is stated exactly with proof and non-cosmetic consequence.

deep_route_exhausted.description: The admitted route exhausted its configured deep allocation without a surviving closure mechanism.

independent_solution_audit_passed.description: One fresh hostile reviewer reconstructed the complete proof or counterexample and verified all dependencies.

independent_solution_audit_failed.description: A fresh hostile reviewer found a repairable or fatal defect in the claimed closure.

standalone_theorem_audit_passed.description: A fresh reviewer reconstructed the intermediate theorem and its stated scope.

standalone_theorem_audit_failed.description: A fresh reviewer rejected the intermediate theorem as stated.

novelty_audit_passed.description: A dated independent search found no prior resolution of the exact closed statement.

novelty_audit_failed.description: Independent novelty review found prior art or a statement mismatch that defeats the claimed resolution.

admission_probe.description: Freeze and verify the problem, eliminate duplicates, and identify one executable bridge or decisive kill test before frontier allocation.

task.objective: Perform a bounded admission investigation. Verify the exact statement and current status, identify the strongest known frontier, design a decisive kill test, and either establish a concrete bridge to closure or reject the candidate. Do not begin an unconstrained long proof search.

bridge_search.description: Prove or decisively kill a theorem-shaped bridge before unlocking deep proof search.

task.objective: Work on the admitted bridge with autonomous proof search and aggressive falsification. Change representations and routes whenever the evidence warrants it. Advance only with a complete bridge statement, proof evidence, and explicit implication interface to the original problem.

bridge_audit.description: Independently reconstruct the bridge before deep resources are authorized.

task.objective: Independently and adversarially reconstruct the frozen bridge from declared evidence. Check every quantifier, dependency, implication to the original problem, and failure regime. Do not continue the creator's proof search.

deep_proof.description: Concentrate long-horizon frontier resources on full closure while preserving paper-scale intermediate theorems.

task.objective: Pursue complete proof or disproof of the frozen open problem from the audited bridge. Run sustained proof-level work rather than another survey. Dynamically branch, merge, falsify, compute, or formalize as useful, but distinguish full closure from a standalone intermediate theorem and from search progress.

independent_solution_audit.description: Run two fresh hostile reconstructions of the claimed complete solution or counterexample.

task.objective: Reconstruct the exact claimed resolution from frozen evidence without inheriting the creator's reasoning. Audit every imported theorem, limiting operation, exceptional case, computation boundary, and statement match. Return a pass only for a complete independently defensible resolution.

independent_intermediate_audit.description: Reconstruct a paper-scale intermediate theorem without mistaking it for closure of the original problem.

task.objective: Independently reconstruct the exact intermediate theorem, its dependencies, sharp scope, and non-cosmetic consequence. Explicitly state that it does not close the original problem unless the original closure gate was separately met.

novelty_audit.description: Verify current novelty and exact statement identity only after mathematical reconstruction passes.

task.objective: Perform an independent, dated primary-source novelty and priority audit for the exact reconstructed resolution. Check equivalent formulations and recent results. Do not weaken or restate the theorem to obtain a pass.

solved.description: The original open problem has a reconstructed and novelty-audited proof or counterexample package.

paper_seed.description: A reconstructed standalone intermediate theorem is preserved for a separate publication-maturation policy; the original problem is not marked solved.

rejected.description: The candidate or admitted route is paused with durable negative evidence and no automatic reseed.
